fig01_training_and_validation: B/C curves show mean ± sample standard deviation across seeds 42, 43 and 44 at each epoch. No smoothing is applied. Training loss and validation mR use different y-axis scales.
fig02_test_bidirectional_recall: Test galleries contain 1000 images and 5000 captions. A is one deterministic zero-shot baseline; B/C bars show means across three seeds, with sample standard deviations. Error bars are not confidence intervals.
fig03_trainable_parameters_vs_test_mR: Trainable parameters follow each training strategy. A has zero trainable parameters but retains the full pretrained model. B/C mR values are three-seed means with sample standard deviations. Points represent different strategies, not a rank sweep.
fig04_encoding_latency_and_throughput: Single Tesla T4, FP32, seed42 checkpoints, unmerged LoRA. Latency bars show synchronized wall-clock means over 100 calls. Throughput uses five rounds of ten batch32 calls. Preprocessing, file I/O and CPU-GPU transfer are outside timing. These are timing measurements, not three-training-seed averages.
